steps.title: Applies on the Careers page
steps.text: Name, mobile, area and experience. No app needed yet.

steps.title: Screens the application and picks a tier
steps.text: Ops starts onboarding at Tier 2 (Trained caregiver).

steps.title: Signs in to the Uday Caregiver app
steps.text: The app shows the 15 onboarding steps and what to do next.

steps.title: Completes her steps and adds a profile photo
steps.text: Profile, Aadhaar check (last 4 digits kept), certificates, fitness note, contract, bank, academy quizzes, and a clear photo of her face.

steps.title: Checks the photo against her ID, clears each stage
steps.text: Screening, references, police verification (result only), certificates, fitness, academy, insurance and kit, shadow shift. The photo is shown to families only after this check.

steps.title: Approved and online for jobs
steps.text: Status becomes active. She switches Online to receive requests.

steps.title: Signs in and adds her parent
steps.text: Own details, then the parent: address, languages, care needs, two emergency contacts, consent. Health details optional.

steps.title: Chooses the care needed
steps.text: "Back home from hospital". Uday suggests Tier 2 or higher.

steps.title: Compares Tier 2 caregivers
steps.text: Verified photo, rating or "New on Uday", verification ticks, skills, price. Links to read reviews, meet first, or book a trial day.

steps.title: Reads her profile
steps.text: Photo checked by Uday, verifications, ratings by area and what other families wrote. Lakshmi is new, so a short call or trial day is suggested.

steps.title: Asks for a 15 minute video call first
steps.text: Offers up to three times. Free. Uday sends a video link or connects both by phone.

steps.title: Picks a time for the call
steps.text: The intro request shows in her Jobs tab.

steps.title: Call confirmed on the dashboard
steps.text: Without a video provider set up yet, Uday calls both at that time.

steps.title: Chooses the weekly day off
steps.text: Live in caregivers get a weekly day off. A relief caregiver of the same tier covers it at no extra cost.

steps.title: Sees the weekly payments
steps.text: Total for the month, but only the first week is held now. Each next week is charged two days before it starts.

steps.title: Confirms what the home provides
steps.text: Toilet, water, a safe place for belongings; for live in also meals, bathing, a sleeping space, breaks and the weekly day off.

steps.title: Request sent, first week held
steps.text: A countdown runs while Lakshmi decides. No acceptance in time releases the hold.

steps.title: Receives the request
steps.text: Urgent alert. Care needed, dates and pay. Address stays hidden until she accepts.

steps.title: Sees the confirmation
steps.text: Booking confirmed with her photo. First week paid; day off cover listed.

steps.title: Ramesh sees who is coming
steps.text: His home screen shows Lakshmi's photo: "Open the door only to the person in this photo."

steps.title: Checks her face, gives the start code
steps.text: The code proves she is at the door; the photo proves who she is.

steps.title: Closes day 1 with the care log
steps.text: Live in: no travel taps and no end code each day. She saves the log and closes the day.

steps.title: Answers "all well?" for the day
steps.text: One tap. "Something was wrong" goes straight to the care manager.

steps.title: Gets the day off request
steps.text: Meena, also Tier 2, is offered day 3. She sees the date, the family area and her pay.

steps.title: Goes on her day off
steps.text: Day 2 closed. Meena covers day 3; Lakshmi enters a welcome back code when she returns.

steps.title: Gives Meena her own start code
steps.text: Relief days have their own start and end codes.

steps.title: Welcome back code for Lakshmi
steps.text: Meena is paid for day 3. Lakshmi enters this code when she is back.

steps.title: Weekly payments
steps.text: Each week is charged two days ahead (here all charged by the test script). A failed charge retries daily and alerts Uday.

steps.title: Last week: extend or change caregiver
steps.text: "Extend care" asks Lakshmi to continue a week or a month. "Ask for a different caregiver" moves the remaining days to someone of the same tier, at the same price.

steps.title: Day 30: the end code
steps.text: The only end code of the month, shown on the last day.

steps.title: Rates the care
steps.text: Five areas averaged (4.8), tags, and a public comment for other families. A private note goes only to Uday.

steps.title: The review now helps the next family
steps.text: Her profile shows the rating by area and the comment, with care type and month, never the family name.

steps.title: Earnings and weekly payout
steps.text: 29 days paid to Lakshmi. Day 3 was paid to Meena, the relief caregiver. Later day offs were covered by Lakshmi in this test run, because relief offers go out 7 days ahead.

steps.title: Care operations queue
steps.text: Caregivers not arrived (alert 30 minutes after start), day off cover for the next 7 days, failed weekly payments, photos to check, intro calls to connect.

gaps: Built: one start code on day 1, the caregiver closes each day with her care log, the family answers "all well?", one end code on the last day.
Weekly day off with relief caregiver

Built: family picks the day off; relief offered 7 days ahead to the next free caregiver of the same tier; own start and end codes; welcome back code; relief caregiver paid for that day. Unfilled: regular caregiver stays and Uday is alerted.
Decide the extra allowance when the regular caregiver covers her own day off.
Built: profile with ratings by area and public comments (no phone numbers or links allowed, no family names shown).
Built: 15 minute intro call request with up to three times, and a "Book a trial day" link.
Choose a video provider (for example Zoom or Google Meet) and set its link; until then Uday connects by phone.
Built: photo upload in the caregiver app, Uday checks it against her ID, families and the senior see it before she arrives.
Built: reminder to the caregiver 1 hour before; 30 minutes after start with no arrival, the family and Uday are alerted and an urgent ticket opens.

Built: family "Ask for a different caregiver" or caregiver "I cannot continue"; Uday proposes a same tier caregiver for the remaining days; same price, nothing charged again; unused money refunded if no one is found.
Built: monthly and quarterly care billed weekly, first week held at request, each week charged two days ahead, failed charges retry daily and alert Uday; "Extend care" in the last week.
The agency must set up UPI Autopay or card mandates with Razorpay for automatic weekly charges.
Built: "Lakshmi is coming" card with her checked photo on the senior home screen, including relief caregivers.
